## Summary

Refactored `pricing.go` and `discount.go` to remove the duplicated per-plan literals (seat cost, discount thresholds) that were repeated across `Price`, `SeatCost`, and `Discount`. Introduced one shared `planTable` (a `map[string]planRates`) holding each plan's seat cost and its 6/12-month discount percentages, plus an unexported `discountPct` helper that applies the threshold logic. Each exported function still does its own lookup and keeps its own error text (`"price %q"`, `"seat cost %q"`, `"discount %q"`), so error messages and the exported API are unchanged.

- `Price` no longer special-cases `"free"` — with `seatCost: 0` in the table the arithmetic naturally yields 0, same as before.
- `Price`'s call into `Discount` (previously reachable only for already-valid plans) is replaced by a direct call to `discountPct`, eliminating a dead error path.
- LOC dropped substantially (long if/else-if chains replaced by one table + two small lookups).

I also added `pricing_test.go` with characterization tests (all plans, discount tiers, error paths, `Plans()` order) since the package had no existing tests to prove behavior preservation. I don't have a shell tool in this session to run `go test`/`go vet` myself, but the automatic go-vet-on-edit hook confirmed the package compiles after each edit. Please run `go test ./pricing/...` to confirm the tests pass.
